Cybersecurity Analyst salary in District of Columbia

Based on 11 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Cybersecurity Analyst jobs in District of Columbia is $128,889–$174,371 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $157,369 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

Which employers list the highest pay?
